**Finding: compliant** — no redline proposed.

The § 19 warranty package sits at (indeed slightly above) the playbook's preferred position:

- **§ 19.1** — Services performed in a professional and workmanlike manner by qualified personnel, per industry standards, plus material conformance of Services and Deliverables to documentation and specifications.
- **§ 19.2** — 90 days for Deliverables measured from the *later* of delivery or acceptance (better than delivery-only), and hosted Services conform *throughout the subscription term*, which exceeds the 12-month software benchmark.
- **§ 19.3** — No malicious code and compliance with Applicable Law, plus no functionality diminishment and open-source protection.
- **§ 19.4** — Full remedy ladder: prompt re-performance/repair/replacement at no charge, then termination of the affected item and refund of Fees paid; expressly non-exclusive for fraud, infringement, confidentiality, privacy, security and indemnified claims.
- **§ 19.5** — Disclaimer is confined to implied warranties and expressly does not limit any express warranty, service level, indemnity or remedy, so it does not swallow the express warranties.

No walk-away "AS IS" language appears anywhere in the document.
